affected_subject.reason: Router swap functions identified as lacking deadline parameter.

trigger_or_action.reason: Submitting a swap without deadline, transaction delayed in mempool and included later.

direct_effect.reason: Swap executes at stale/worse price, user receives less value than intended.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual price/value relation and industry-standard deadline guarantee derivable.

summary: Fragments identify Router swap functions lacking deadline protection, the delayed-execution trigger, the resulting worse-price execution, and the expected-vs-actual value relation.
